propositions: pip-audit job fails on every patchset against main due to click 8.2.1 vulnerability PYSEC-2026-2132 (command injection in click.edit), blocking Verified +1 votes
inspect-ai (via [eval] extra) pins click to <8.2.2 via constraint click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3, preventing direct lock bump to 8.3.3+
uv resolves all extras jointly, so click 8.2.1 is the newest version satisfying the combined constraint set without override
override-dependencies=["click>=8.3.3"] in [tool.uv] section allows uv.lock to resolve click 8.4.2 while keeping inspect-ai pinned, making the stale cap explicit and removable
inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports cleanly and runs under click 8.4.2 (cap is stale, not a real incompatibility); upstream PR to relax the cap is open but unmerged
fix landed on main as commit 31844d5f9fb with pyproject.toml override directive and uv.lock refresh; pip-audit now passes and reports no known vulnerabilities
